withholding.name: West Virginia State Tax Department, Tax Division

efile.text: For periods beginning after December 31, 2024, any employer that uses a payroll service or is required to file a withholding return for more than 10 employees shall file the returns electronically. Failure to do so can result in a penalty of $25 per employee for whom the return was not filed electronically.

epay.text: Any employer whose tax liability exceeds $50,000 during the previous calendar year is required to make all payments by Electronic Funds Transfer.

returns.name: West Virginia quarterly withholding return
contents: Due the last day of the month following the end of the quarter; not required of annual filers.

returns.name: Form WV/IT-103, Year End Reconciliation, with W-2 copies
contents: A copy of each employee's W-2 goes to the Tax Division with the reconciliation no later than January 31; employees get their W-2 by January 31.
Employers who use a payroll service or file for more than 10 employees file electronically (penalty $25 per employee otherwise); smaller filers are encouraged to use MyTaxes.

deposits.interpretation: West Virginia employers remit the tax withheld on or before the 15th day of the succeeding month (MONTHLY) and file a quarterly return by the last day of the month after the quarter that reconciles the three months. Employers who withhold LESS than $600 annually, or who employ certain domestic and household employees, file the annual return and pay once a year, due January 31 of the succeeding year (ANNUAL; an input, never derived: the page gives the $600 figure as a continuing exception). No other schedule is described, so there is no semi-weekly rule modelled and no look-back derivation: monthly is the default.
